title: Pallet Town — new game, outside Red's house
description: A genuine new game, walked out of Red's front door. The party is EMPTY: this is before OAK's lab, so there is no starter PIKACHU yet and no follower. Pick 'Viridian City' if you want the starter already in hand.

title: Viridian City
description: Walked up Route 1 from Pallet. Nothing faked.

title: Pewter City — before BROCK
description: In Pewter City with the gym untouched: the fixture to start from if you want to fight BROCK yourself. Viridian Forest's five trainers are pre-flagged as beaten so the walk-in wasn't interrupted.

title: Pewter City — BOULDERBADGE won (faked)
description: Standing below the PEWTER GYM door with BOULDERBADGE. The badge and the gym's event flags are WRITTEN, not fought — BROCK is still in there and TM39 is not in the bag. Use the 'before BROCK' preset for the real fight.

title: Cerulean City
description: Cerulean's west entrance, walked in through Mt. Moon on foot. Mt. Moon B2F's JESSIE & JAMES are pre-flagged as beaten; everything else is real.

title: Cerulean City — CASCADEBADGE won (faked)
description: One tile below the CERULEAN GYM door with BOULDERBADGE + CASCADEBADGE, so CUT is usable. The badge and the gym flags are WRITTEN, not fought, and TM18 is NOT in the bag. Use 'Cerulean City' for the real fight.

title: S.S. TICKET in hand (BILL's house done)
description: Outside BILL's Sea Cottage on Route 25 with the whole cutscene really played: S.S. TICKET in KEY ITEMS and the Cerulean guards stood aside. Nothing faked — this is the state to start anything past Cerulean from.

title: Vermilion City
description: Vermilion's north entrance, walked down Route 6. Six Route 5/6 trainers are pre-flagged as beaten so the walk wasn't interrupted.

title: HM01 CUT from the CAPTAIN
description: In the S.S. ANNE captain's room with HM01 CUT really taken. The 2F rival battle is FAKED (its flag is set so the corridor is walkable), so don't use this one to test that fight.

title: Vermilion City — THUNDERBADGE in hand
description: Vermilion's north entrance after the S.S. ANNE has sailed, carrying THUNDERBADGE, HM01 CUT (really earned) and TM86 THUNDERBOLT. LT.SURGE, his three trainers and the trash-can puzzle are all FAKED, not played — this is a post-Surge start point, not a pre-fight one.

title: Route 9 (post-Vermilion)
description: Route 9's west edge, one step in from Cerulean. CUT IS FAKED here: THUNDERBADGE, HM01 and CUT in the lead POKéMON's move slot are written in so the route's cut tree can be opened. The route's own trainers are untouched.

title: Lavender Town
description: The Route 10 arrival tile in Lavender Town, walked through Rock Tunnel. Rock Tunnel's fifteen trainers and Route 10's south-lobe four are pre-flagged as beaten; the rest is real.

title: Route 8
description: Route 8's east end, one step west of Lavender Town. Nothing faked.

title: POKéMON TOWER 2F — the rival is waiting
description: At the foot of the 1F stairs on 2F. NOTHING is faked: the rival scene on row 5 is still armed, and row 5 is the floor's only corridor, so this is the fixture to start from if you want that fight.

title: POKéMON TOWER 3F
description: 3F, at the foot of 2F's west stairs. The 2F RIVAL BATTLE IS FAKED — its flag is written so the 2F corridor is walkable — so don't use this one to test that fight. All three 3F channelers are untouched.

title: POKéMON TOWER 4F
description: 4F, at the foot of 3F's east stairs. Carries the faked 2F rival flag; 3F's and 4F's channelers are all untouched.

title: POKéMON TOWER 5F
description: 5F, at the foot of 4F's west stairs. Carries the faked 2F rival flag, plus two 4F channelers (AGNES and EDITH) flagged as beaten — EDITH's line of sight covers the only tiles joining 4F's two halves. 5F is untouched.

title: POKéMON TOWER 6F — the ghost MAROWAK is waiting
description: 6F, at the foot of 5F's east stairs, with the PURIFIED ZONE heal really taken on the way. Carries the faked 2F rival and 4F channeler flags; all four 5F channelers and everything on 6F are untouched, so the restless soul is still on its tile — and there is no SILPH SCOPE in the bag.

title: POKéMON TOWER 7F — JESSIE & JAMES and MR FUJI
description: The top of the Tower, at the foot of 6F's south stairs, with 6F's RARE CANDY really taken. Three 6F obstacles are FAKED past: channelers NORA and VERA, and THE GHOST MAROWAK — its flag is written, so this preset cannot test the SILPH SCOPE reveal (use 'POKéMON TOWER 6F' for that). JESSIE & JAMES and the MR FUJI rescue are untouched.

title: CELADON CITY
description: Celadon's east entrance, walked in from Route 7. The whole city, the GYM, the DEPT. STORE, the MANSION (EEVEE) and the DINER (COIN CASE) are real and unplayed. CUT is faked (HM01 + CUT in the lead POKéMON) so Erika's cut tree and gym plants can be opened; the GAME CORNER, PRIZE ROOM and ROCKET HIDEOUT are real and unplayed too.

title: CELADON CITY — RAINBOWBADGE won (faked)
description: One tile below the CELADON GYM door with the RAINBOWBADGE and TM21 MEGA DRAIN WRITTEN, not fought (ERIKA and her seven trainers are flagged beaten), so STRENGTH is usable. Use 'CELADON CITY' for the real fight.

title: CELADON CITY — COIN CASE in hand
description: One tile below the GAME CORNER door with the COIN CASE really collected from the DINER. Chains from 'CELADON CITY' (CUT faked, no RAINBOWBADGE); nothing else is faked. The GAME CORNER, PRIZE ROOM and ROCKET HIDEOUT are real and unplayed.

title: CELADON GAME CORNER — hideout stairs found
description: Inside the GAME CORNER on the tile under the hideout staircase, with the POSTER read for real and the COIN CASE in hand. One thing is FAKED: the Rocket guarding the poster is flagged beaten, not fought. The whole ROCKET HIDEOUT below (grunts, items, LIFT KEY, GIOVANNI) is unplayed.

title: ROCKET HIDEOUT B4F — SILPH SCOPE in hand
description: GIOVANNI's tile on B4F after his defeat, with the SILPH SCOPE really picked up from the ball he leaves behind. FAKED: the LIFT KEY was poked into the bag, JESSIE & JAMES and GIOVANNI are flagged beaten, not fought; the grunts and items on B1F-B3F are untouched. Made for walking back to LAVENDER and testing the POKéMON TOWER ghost reveal on the real SCOPE.

title: ROUTE 16 — west of CELADON
description: The Route 16 side of Celadon's west seam, walked in from the city. Chains from 'CELADON CITY' (CUT faked, no RAINBOWBADGE, no BICYCLE): the gate's BICYCLE check, the FLY house (HM02), SNORLAX #2, the CYCLING ROAD and ROUTE 18 are all real and unplayed.

title: FUCHSIA CITY — BILL's grandpa's doorstep
description: Fuchsia City, walked in along the CYCLING ROAD and ROUTE 18 from the 'ROUTE 16' chain (CUT faked, no RAINBOWBADGE, no BICYCLE). Routes 13/14/15, the city, its houses, the WARDEN and the GYM are all real and unplayed; the SAFARI ZONE gate is not open yet in this build.

title: FUCHSIA CITY — SOULBADGE won (faked)
description: One tile below the FUCHSIA GYM door with all five badges written and TM06 in the bag. FAKED: KOGA and his six trainers are flagged beaten, not fought. Use 'FUCHSIA CITY' for the real gym.
